steps.title: Review Current Application Architecture
steps.description: Inspect ApexCalc component tree, layout hierarchies, and activity lifecycle.

steps.title: Design App Startup Loader Overlay
steps.description: Construct startup splash loader screen layout with progress indicator, branding title, and status messaging.

steps.title: Implement Initialization Lifecycle Handler
steps.description: Configure Android Handler in MainActivity to orchestrate initialization and transition timings without external libraries.

steps.title: Create Loader Animation and Transition Logic
steps.description: Implement smooth fade-out animation and interactive state unblocking once the calculator is ready.

steps.title: Ensure Offline Math Engine Readiness
steps.description: Verify MathEvaluator and calculation dependencies initialize reliably during startup phase.

steps.title: Validate SharedPreferences and History Preload
steps.description: Ensure calculation history data loads asynchronously prior to loader dismissal.

steps.title: Integrate Back Button and Panel Protections
steps.description: Ensure back press handles loader visibility gracefully without crashing or interrupting initialization.

steps.title: Verify UI Theme and Color Consistency
steps.description: Check that the loader screen matches the existing dark theme palette and styling aesthetics.

steps.title: Test Screen Rotation and Soft Input Behavior
steps.description: Confirm loader state transitions reliably across orientation changes and state restorations.

steps.title: Building ApexCalc
steps.description: Assemble and compile debug APK package with new startup loader.
